module: Manual zoom filter: changes the field of view (FOV, in degrees) according to MoveManager.zoomIn / zoomOut, clamped between fovMin and fovMax, and displays the FOV via ui_message when it changes. Used by other modes (onboard, bigMap...). Does nothing in an OpenXR session. Returns a constructor.
notes: Zoom speed: 4.5 * dt * (zoomIn - zoomOut) * fov (proportional to the current FOV).
Default values: fovDefault 80, fovMin 10, fovMax 120, uiTxt "ui.camera.fov". The extracted page says init(fovMin, fovMax, uiTxt) but the code has four parameters, fovDefault first.

C.desc: Zoom filter. Fields: fov (current), fovDefault, fovMin, fovMax, uiTxt.

init.desc: Initializes the limits and resets the FOV to fovDefault.

update.desc: Applies the input zoom and writes data.res.fov.

returns.desc: true if the FOV changed by at least 0.1 degree (message displayed); false in OpenXR
